description: This file defines a React functional component named Modal, which provides a reusable modal dialog with overlay, header offset handling, focus trap, and styling. It manages visibility, accessibility, and user interactions such as closing on backdrop click or ESC key.

methods.name: Modal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal dialog with customizable props such as title, open state, onClose handler, header offset, z-indexes, width, footer, and className. It handles ESC key closing, dynamic positioning, and styling.
